Getting Started with Public Sector Solutions Trial Org with OmniScripts

Public Sector Solutions, along with other Salesforce capabilities makes the licensing and permitting processes and inspections easy to manage. You can create user profiles and person accounts to store customer information, automate your business processes, and use the Vlocity Digital Platform to create guided interactions using data from your Salesforce org and external sources.


Set Up an Organization-Wide Email Address

Define a list of organization-wide addresses for different user profiles. For more details on setting up email addresses, refer to our documentation here. For additional information on organization-wide email addresses, read more here.

  1. Go to Setup > Email > Organization-Wide Addresses.
  2. Click Add to add a single email address to a user profile or all user profiles based on your need.



-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Create Your Experience Cloud Site

Sites are a great way to share information and collaborate with your constituents. Once you’ve created your Experience Cloud site, you can customize the default pages provided by Salesforce at any time.


Enable Digital Experiences


  1. Go to Setup > Feature Settings > Digital Experiences > Settings.
  2. Select Enable Digital Experiences.
  3. Enter a domain name and click Check Availability.
  4. If your chosen domain name is available, click Save to enable your Experience Site. You can find additional information here.

Create Licenses & Permits Site

You can create an Experience Cloud site with the Licenses and Permits template.


  1. Go to Setup > Feature Settings > Digital Experiences > All Sites.
  2. Click New.
  3. Choose the Licenses And Permits template.
  4. Click Get Started.
  5. Give your site a Name and URL and click Create.
  6. You will be directed to Workspaces.
  7. Click Administration to make the following changes:
    1. On the Settings page, click Activate. Click OK to confirm.
    2. On the Members page, under the Select Profiles section, click on the Search dropdown and choose Customer. Move your chosen profile, such as LPI Community Plus User, from the Available Profiles table to the Selected Profiles table. Click Save.
    3. Optionally, you can follow the steps below to self register a profile.
      1. Go to Login & Registration. Under the Registration Page Configuration section, select the Allow customers and partners to self-register checkbox.
      2. Choose  a Profile (for example, LPI Community Plus User) from the dropdown and click Save.

Setup necessary List Views for Digital Experience Users

List views help create a scrollable list of records that meet your filter criteria.


  • From the App Launcher (9 dots at the top left corner), search and open Individual Applications.
    • Create a new List view by clicking on the Gear icon for List View Controls. To read more about creating or cloning a list view, click here.
    • Enter a List Name. For example, My Individual Applications.
    • Choose who can see this list view. If you choose the option Share list view with groups of users, then, from the Search dropdown list, choose All Customer Portal Users and click Save.
    • Click on the Filter icon to set Filter by Owner as “All individual applications”, click Done.
    • Under Filters, select Add Filter.
      • From the Field dropdown choose Returned to Applicant.
      • Choose the Operator value as equals.
      • Set the Value as False.
      • Click Done.
      • Save the filter.
    • Repeat the process above to create another list view for Returned Applications
      • Sample name - My Returned Individual Applications.
      • Set Filter by Owner as All individual applications.
      • Set filter values - Returned to Applicant equals True.
      • Click Done.
      • Save the filter.
  • From the App Launcher (9 dots at the top left corner), search and open Business License Applications.
    • Follow the steps as listed above for Individual Applications to create list views for Business License Applications.
    • Sample name - My Business Applications
      • Set Filter by Owner as All business license applications and click Done. Save the filter.
      • Add a new filter and set filter values - Returned to Applicant equals False.
      • Click Done.
      • Save the filter.
    • Sample name - My Returned Business Applications
      • Set Filter by Owner as All business license applications and click Done. Save the filter.
      • Add a new filter and set filter values - Returned to Applicant equals True.
      • Click Done.
      • Save the filter.

Setup Process Automation

An automated approval process enables you to respond to approval requests directly from the home page, or through in-app and email notifications. 


  • Go to Setup > Process Automation > Approval Processes.
  • From the Manage Approval Processes dropdown, choose Business License Application.
    • Open the first approval process to view its details and click Activate. You can also click on the Activate link against each approval process. Click OK to confirm.
    • Repeat the above step for the remaining two processes as well.
  • Now, choose Individual Application from the Manage Approval Processes dropdown list. 
    • Open the first approval process to view its details and click Activate. You can also click on the Activate link against each approval process. Click OK to confirm.
    • Repeat the above step for the remaining two processes as well.
  • Go to Setup > Process Automation > Process Builder.
    • On the My Processes page, activate the below mentioned processes in Process Builder. Open each process and click Activate and click Confirm.
      • Submit BLA for Approval
      • Submit IA for Approval
      • Note: Click View All Processes to return to the My Processes page.
  • Open Trigger Vlocity License Assignment.
    • Click on the decision box “Is Community User?”
    • On the Define Criteria for this Action Group page, on the right, verify the condition solved for the new Community User Profile created above.
    • Else, update the condition and click Save.
    • Activate the process and click Confirm.
    • This process triggers the auto-assignment of Vlocity License for the chosen community user.
  • Go to Setup > Process Automation > Flows
    • Open each flow mentioned below and click Activate.
      • Create Fees associated with Violation Enforcement Action
      • Create Visit from SF Maps for BLA
      • Setup Associated Location
      • Update BLA Business Site Address
      • Update BLA Status for RCV change
      • Update BLA Status for Visit
      • Vlocity License ID Flow

Configure OmniScripts

With OmniScripts, you can create a guided interaction to match the flow of your process. OmniScript is a declarative scripting tool that allows you to create a script with clicks and not code.


  1. Verify the Vlocity Cards Configuration.
    1. From App Launcher, search and open Vlocity Cards.
    2. If you see a Warnings button, open it. Click Fix.
  2. Update the Save for Later configuration in OmniScripts.
    1. Go to Setup > Feature Settings > Digital Experiences > All Sites. Note your digital experience site URL. For example, https://newlpitrial.force.com/lpi.
    2. From the App Launcher (9 dots at the top left corner), search and open Omniscripts.
    3. Update the URL for Apply for Business Authorization
      1. On the OmniStudio page, expand Licensing And Permitting/Business License Application and click on Business License Application.
      2. On the OmniScript Designer page, select Script Configuration. You can view all the properties of the Script Configuration on the right. Click Deactivate Version.
      3. Scroll down and select CUSTOM HTML TEMPLATES and expand the section.
      4. In the script displayed, find “OmniScriptInstanceId”. There will be 3 occurrences.
      5. Here, replace the old community URL with your new community URL. For example, https://olddomain.force.com/s/resume-application?OmniScriptInstanceId with https://newdomain.force.com/s/resume-application?OmniScriptInstanceId.
      6. Click Activate Version.
    4. Update URL for “Assess Your License or Permit Needs”
      1. On the OmniStudio page, expand Licensing And Permitting/Prescreening and click on Prescreening.
      2. On the OmniScript Designer page, select Script Configuration. You can view all the properties of the Script Configuration on the right. Click Deactivate Version.
      3. Scroll down and select CUSTOM HTML TEMPLATES and expand the section.
      4. In the script displayed, find “OmniScriptInstanceId”. There will be 3 occurrences.
      5. Here, replace the old community URL with your new community URL. For example, https://olddomain.force.com/s/resume-application-ps?OmniScriptInstanceId with https://newdomain.force.com/s/resume-application-ps?OmniScriptInstanceId.
      6. Click Activate Version.
    5. Update URL for “Apply for Individual Authorization”
      1. On the OmniStudio page, expand Licensing And Permitting/New Doctors License and click MEDICINE AND OSTEOPATHY (MD/DO) NEW LICENSE APPLICATION.
      2. On the OmniScript Designer page, select Script Configuration. You can view all the properties of the Script Configuration on the right. Click Deactivate Version.
      3. Scroll down and select CUSTOM HTML TEMPLATES and expand the section.
      4. In the script displayed, find “OmniScriptInstanceId”. There will be 3 occurrences.
      5. Here, replace the old community URL with your new community URL. For example, https://olddomain.force.com/s/resume-application-ia?OmniScriptInstanceId with https://newdomain.force.com/s/resume-application-ia?OmniScriptInstanceId.
      6. Click Activate Version.

Licenses & Permits Experience Setup

Configure and set up your site to give your constituents easy access to view records.


  • Go to Setup > Feature Settings > Digital Experiences > All Sites.
  • Choose the new Experience Site created by you and click Builder. For more additional information on customizing Sites with Experience Builder, click here.
  • Click Preview (the eye icon at the top right corner). Go to License and Permits > Assess Your License or Permit Needs.
    • Click Back to Builder on the top right corner.
    • Click Components [the lightning bolt component at the top left corner]. From the Custom Components dropdown, drag and drop the Vlocity OmniScript component to the content area.
    • In the Vlocity Omniscript dialog, choose the following information:
      • Type - Licensing And Permitting
      • Subtype - Prescreening
      • Language - English for Pre-screening Omniscript
      • Provide max height px [for example, 900] for the component
  • Click Preview. Go to License and Permits -> Apply for a License or Permit.
    • Click Back to Builder on the top right corner.
    • Click Components [the lightning bolt component at the top left corner]. From the Custom Components dropdown, drag and drop the Vlocity OmniScript component to the content area.
    • In the Vlocity Omniscript dialog, choose the following information:
      • Type - Licensing And Permitting
      • Subtype - Business License Application
      • Language - English for Business License Application Omniscript 
      • Provide max height px [for example, 900] for the component
  • Add a new Standard page to your Experience Cloud Site. For more help on adding a new page, click here. 
    • Click Components [the lightning bolt component at the top left corner]. From the Custom Components dropdown, drag and drop the Vlocity OmniScript component to the content area.
    • In the Vlocity Omniscript dialog, choose the following information:
      • Type - Licensing And Permitting
      • Subtype - New Doctors License
      • Language - English for Individual Application Omniscript 
      • Provide max height px [for example, 900] for the component
    • To add the newly created page to the navigation menu, go back to Builder mode. Click on the site navigation page section to open the Theme Navigation Menu.
    • In the Theme Navigation Menu dialog, click the Edit Default Navigation button.
    • In the Edit Default Navigation screen, click Add Menu Item. Give your menu item a Name [For example, Apply for an Individual License or Permit], set the Type as Site Page and Page as the New Page created.
    • Drag and drop this newly created menu item under License and Permits menu item.

  • Similarly, add additional pages to your License/Permit Application OmniScripts.

Create Action Plan Template

Create action plan templates with different sets of tasks.


  1. From the App Launcher, find and open Action Plan Templates, and then click New.
  2. Enter a name and description for the template. For example, Salon Establishment License Template.
  3. Select the Action Plan Type as Visit Execution.
  4. Set Target Object as Visit.
  5. Click Save to create a draft Action Plan Template.
  6. Under the Assessment Task Definition section, click the Add Assessment Task Definition button.
  7. In the Add Assessment Task Definition dialog, choose a previously created assessment task definition. For example, chooseSalon Health and Safety - Building Standards
  8. Set the Display Order as 1 and click Save. Note: If you don’t provide a display order number sequence, it is automatically set to 0.
  9. You can add additional assessment task definitions, tasks, signature tasks to the template. After you’ve added your chosen items, click Publish Template.

Creating Additional Users and Assigning Permission Sets

  • You can create users for various roles and profiles based on your organization’s needs. This trial org has some sample roles and profiles for Compliance Officer, Intake Officer, Inspection Manager, and Inspector.
  • For users to access and perform actions, permission sets will need to be assigned. To learn more about assigning permissions, click here.
  • The below mentioned permission sets are recommended to access all Public Sector entities.
    • Public Sector Access
    • Industries Visit
    • ActionPlans
  • The below mentioned permission sets are suggested to be added if you need access to Inspection-related entities and limited access to other Public Sector entities.
    • Public Sector Field Access
    • Industries Visit
    • ActionPlans
  • To explore Salesforce Maps, which is part of this trial but will not be included as part of Public Sector Solutions, you will need to set permission to your users. You can read more about it here.

Important Note for Apply Business Authorization OmniScript

  • The Omniscript provided in the trial is an example script, it is configured to work only for a single flow. You will need to configure other flows as per your need. The Community User should be a Person Account that is linked to a Business Account. To try this OmniScript, use the data detailed below if you want to submit Business Applications as a Business Owner from the Experience Cloud Site. 
    • Industry > Personal Care Services
    • Business Activity > Beauty Salon
    • Authorization Category > License
    • Authorization Type > Salon Establishment License
  • This detail is controlled in the step "exprShowMinnesotaSalonLicenceApplication" in the OmniScript Configuration.
  • To trigger fees on creation of a Violation Enforcement action with the provided example, set the Violation Type of the parent Regulatory Code Violation as Failure to have the shop properly ventilated.
